experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and lanterns, exclusively chartered for two. Sail through turquoise lagoons as the sun dips below the horizon, sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners seeking intimacy and breathtaking natural beauty.

experiences.name: Snorkeling Safari at Hanifaru Bay Biosphere Reserve
experiences.description: Join a guided snorkeling excursion to UNESCO-recognized Hanifaru Bay, one of the world's most spectacular marine feeding grounds. Swim alongside majestic manta rays and whale sharks in their natural habitat during aggregation season. A knowledgeable marine biologist guide accompanies the trip, providing insights into the ecosystem. Equipment, boat transfer, and light refreshments are included.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a signature couples' spa ritual at an overwater or semi-submerged spa pavilion with a glass floor revealing the vibrant reef below. Experience a 90-minute Maldivian-inspired treatment using coconut oil, sea salt scrubs, and tropical botanicals. The sound of gentle waves and the sight of colorful fish gliding beneath you create an unparalleled luxurious and romantic atmosphere.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the Indian Ocean. A personal butler sets up a beautifully styled picnic with fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and chilled rosé wine. Spend hours swimming in the crystal-clear shallows, snorkeling the surrounding reef, and basking in total seclusion — just the two of you and the endless ocean horizon.
experiences.location: Veligandu Island Area, North Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Cultural Tour
experiences.description: Visit the charming local island of Maafushi for an authentic cultural immersion. Explore the island on foot, visit a traditional fishing community, and learn about Maldivian heritage and crafts. Then join a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef, preparing classic dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks. Enjoy your creations for lunch with ocean views.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives
